_source: Phase 2 (shad-8b). Only facts stated in the Shopify product descriptions (data/store.json, 2026-11-19). Thread count, GSM, weave, origin, ratings and certifications are deliberately empty until the user supplies verified data. See docs/reference/editorial-content-sources.md.

fields.name: Cotton satin
fields.summary: A smooth cotton satin with a subtle sheen. We use it for our yarn-dyed bed sheet sets and our two-tone reversible duvet cover sets.
fields.description:
Cotton satin has a smooth finish that feels gentle on the skin and a subtle sheen that makes a bed look put-together.

Our yarn-dyed bed sheet sets are coloured before the fabric is woven, which gives them rich, long-lasting colour. Our two-tone duvet cover sets pair a deep shade on one side with a lighter tone on the other, so you can flip the cover and change the mood of the room.

The bed sheets in both sets resist wrinkles, so the bed stays neat with very little effort.

fields.name: Quilted cotton
fields.tagline: A raised pattern with no loose threads
fields.summary: Soft cotton with ultrasonic quilting: a raised, embossed pattern that stays neat, light enough for summer and a cosy layer in winter.
fields.description:
Our quilted bed sheet sets are made from soft cotton. Instead of thread, the layers are joined with ultrasonic heat to create a raised, embossed pattern, so there are no stitches to break and no loose threads to pull or fray.

It is light enough for summer nights and adds a cosy layer in winter, so it can stay on the bed all year. The fabric resists wrinkles, so the bed looks freshly made with very little effort.
fields.care: Machine wash at 40°C. Do not bleach. Tumble dry on low.

fields.name: Microfibre duvet fill
fields.summary: A silky microfibre shell around a 100% polyester fill, in a clean white that slips into any duvet cover.
fields.description:
Our Duvet Comfort Filling is the insert that goes inside a duvet cover. The silky microfibre shell feels smooth and breathable, and the 100% polyester fill stays light and evenly spread.

The 220 GSM fill weight gives dependable winter warmth with a balanced loft that does not feel heavy. GSM is the weight of the filling per square metre.

fields.name: Cotton cover, microfibre fill
fields.tagline: Soft support that holds its shape
fields.summary: A 100% pure cotton cover filled with 100% polyester microfibre, used for our Duvet Comfort Pillow.
fields.description:
Each Duvet Comfort Pillow has a 100% pure cotton cover that feels soft and breathable against the skin. Inside, 100% polyester microfibre gives plush, even support that holds its shape night after night.

The pillows are light, airy and comfortable in every season, and the white finish goes with any pillow cover.
